member.name: T:KineticaRT.Logic.Expressions.Expression
member.summary: KineticaRT Channel that evaluates expressions containing other Channels.
member.remarks:
Expressions can include other channels such as expressions and driver channels. The value of the expression will be re-evaluated as and when the channels change.
Unlike other real-time systems which continually evaluate all expressions, a KineticaRT expression object will only use processor time when the inputs to the expression actually change and even then will only re-evaluate the parts of the expression which need re-evaluation.
This makes it especially suitable for use with drivers with different update rates and digital inputs which rarely change.
The expression object supports standard mathamatical operators and functions plus a selection of time based functions such as the RollingSD function.

member.name: M:KineticaRT.Logic.Expressions.Expression.SetValue(KineticaRT.Values.Value)
member.summary: Sets a new current value of the expression.
member.remarks: This is required as the "set" for the Value property of the Expression is non-functional. The new value will be overwritten by the calculated value of the expression as soon as the expression is re-evaluated, normally when one of it's inputs next changes. As a result this function is normally only of use during initialisation.
member.param: The new value for the expression.

member.name: P:KineticaRT.Logic.Expressions.Expression.Text
member.summary: Gets or sets the expression to be evaluated.
member.remarks:
This should be set to the text of the mathematical expression. The text may include channel names, brackets and the following operators and functions:
Unary Operators
+ - Positive.
- - Negative
Binary Operators
+ - Addition.
- - Subtraction
* - Multiplication
/ - Division
÷ - Division
Comparison Operators
< - Less than
≤ - Less than or equal to
≥ - Greater than or equal to
<= - Less than or equal to
>= - Greater than or equal to
> - Greater than
≠ - Not equal to
<> - Not equal to
= - Equal to
Logical Operators
NOT - Logical Not
AND - Logical And
OR - Logical Or
XOR - Logical Xor
Functions
Abs(a) - Absolute Value
Atan(a) - Arctangent (Radians)
Choose(a,b[,c...]) - If a = 1 then result = b. If a = 2 then result = c etc.
Cos(a) - Cosine (Radians)
Exp(a) - Exponential
Filter(a, t) - a low pass filtered using time constant t
Floor (a) - Largest integer less than or equal to a
If (a,b,c) - If a = true then result = b else result = c
Limit (a,min,max) - Constrain within man/max values
Log(a[,base]) - Natural logarithm / Logarithm to specified base
Max(a,b[,c...]) - Maximam of series
Mean(a,b[,c...]) - Mean of a series
Min(a,b[,c...]) - Minimum of a series
Pow(a,b) - a raised to the power b
RollingMean(a,period) - Mean over a rolling time period
RollingSD(a,period) - Standard Deviation over a rolling time period
Sin(a) - Sine (Radians)
Sqrt(a) - Square root
Tan(a) - Tangent (Radians)
Each of the parameters is treated as a sub-expression and is evaluated before being operated on by the function.
All time periods are in seconds.
